headline: Nigerian Exchange Market Capitalization Declines by 3.52 Trillion Naira
summary: The Nigerian Exchange (NGX) saw its equity market capitalization fall by 3.52 trillion naira in the week ending November 6, 2026, with the All-Share Index dropping 2.13%.
why: A significant decline in market capitalization reflects broad investor sentiment and can be driven by macroeconomic factors or sector-specific downturns.

impacts.name: NGX All-Share Index
impacts.why: The index decline directly reflects the loss in total market capitalization.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Broad-based selling pressure across the exchange led to a contraction in total equity value.
